description: Each bound on the words a source's offered schemas keep as written (#308, ADR-0006), at its limit and one past it, and the schema budget a source past one leaves to the others. A source past a bound is made a catalogue: its tools are offered as catalogue entries and its schemas reach the model only in load_tool's answer, framed as data. declared are the host's tools (each language pins its own fixture's tool-list digest), policy any bound a case sets over the harness's defaults, offered what the model reads of each tool offered (name, description, the schema's JSON text) and its taxonomy, in the order offered, and withheld the guardrails the offer raises, in order. The file is ASCII, every other character escaped, so a lone surrogate is read as the escape it is. Handwritten: the expected offers were built outside either implementation, from ADR-0006's words, with the fixed marker; a run draws its own. toolSources.test.ts and go/context/schema_bounds_test.go hold offerSources to each case, and the limits to the exported bounds.
